rating_definitions.substantial: Direct primary records independently checked, historical interpretive narrative prepared, site/current access and image rights cleared.
rating_definitions.developing: Specific explanatory claim and source locators exist; original/independent corroboration or field condition remains unverified.
rating_definitions.sparse: Key document, named location, contested interpretation, or physical feature not yet verified.
rating_definitions.missing: Essential evidence, permissions, or on-site interpretation absent; no source-located visitor-ready claim.
